svg.title: Zig main versus Goose K1: fresh compile time

cc:Work.dc:title: Zig main versus Goose K1: fresh compile time
cc:Work.dc:description: Vertical gold and mint shard stacks show actual median milliseconds and observed ranges. Shorter is quicker. Call chains: Zig 8.65ms, Goose 5.23ms. Guarded arithmetic: 22.27/24.90ms. Static domains: 7.71/13.03ms. Synthetic program builds, not compiler executable rebuilds or gdev.
